coverage.note: Coverage compares member codes against compiled area releases only. An unresolved code is not a claim that the place is missing, and a resolved one is not a claim of equal geometry. `complete` means every listed code resolved, which a location spanning several vintages never does; `coversLocation` is the one to read, and means every code that did not resolve was either the wrong vintage for this release or a legacy alias naming no compiled area, rather than an unexplained absence. Codes of the second kind are listed separately in `legacy`.
